title: quantale-enriched-cosheaf
description: The dual of a Q-enriched sheaf on a Grothendieck site: a covariant Q-functor whose values spread out along covers via a coequalizer condition rather than restricting along them via an equalizer. Generated by dualizing the Q-enriched sheaf.

functor.description: a covariant functor F-check : T -> Q-Cat_cwl from the Grothendieck site to complete weighted lattices

variance.description: dual to the sheaf: extension maps F-check(s -> t) : F-check(s) -> F-check(t) run in the same direction as the site morphism

coequalizerCondition.description: for every covering family {f_i : U_i -> U} in J, the canonical Q-functor Coeq( disjoint F-check(U_i x_U U_j) => disjoint F-check(U_i) ) -> F-check(U) is an equivalence of complete weighted lattices

extensionMaps.description: values extend (spread out) from smaller to larger objects; the right Q-adjoints of the dual sheaf's restrictions serve as these extensions, grounding the Verdier-duality equivalence
